messages.message: my phone is barely working and im so annoyed 😡
Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Sana. How can I help you today?
my signal is gone and i cant even make calls. this is ridiculous
I am sorry to hear that you're having trouble with your device. I know how frustrating it is to be disconnected.
Before we look into this, could you please provide your account number?
Thank you, Rohan. Let me check the line. Is the phone number associated with the account 96906 74182?
yeah that's it. email is rohan.63@examplemail.com
I've checked the system and it looks like there is a fault with the SIM card itself. It's likely damaged.
seriously? i just want it fixed now
I can definitely help with that. I'll send a replacement SIM to your address on file.
oh okay, thanks a lot Sana! you've been great
